question: मेरी मैटरनिटी लीव कितने हफ्ते की होगी?
english: How many weeks of maternity leave will I get?
expected: Up to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave (12 weeks if two or more surviving children).

question: मेरे ऑफर लेटर में मैटरनिटी लीव सही लिखी है क्या?
english: Is the maternity leave in my offer letter correct?
expected: No. The letter gives 12 weeks but the law gives up to 26 weeks; the clause needs attention.

question: मला किती आठवड्यांची प्रसूती रजा मिळेल?
english: How many weeks of maternity leave will I get?
expected: Up to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave.

question: Maine baby adopt kiya hai, kya mujhe maternity leave milegi?
english: I have adopted a baby, will I get maternity leave?
expected: Yes, an adopting mother gets 12 weeks of maternity benefit.

question: गर्भपात होने पर कितनी छुट्टी मिलती है?
english: How much leave is given in case of miscarriage?
expected: 6 weeks of paid leave after the miscarriage.

question: Does my company need to have a creche?
english: Does my company need to have a creche?
expected: Yes, if the establishment has 50 or more employees.

question: क्या मुझे मैटरनिटी लीव के दौरान नौकरी से निकाला जा सकता है?
english: Can I be fired during maternity leave?
expected: No, dismissal during or because of maternity absence is not allowed.

question: बाळाला दूध पाजण्यासाठी कामावर ब्रेक मिळतो का?
english: Do I get breaks at work to feed my baby?
expected: Yes, two nursing breaks a day until the child is 15 months old.

question: ऑफिस में यौन उत्पीड़न की शिकायत कहाँ करें?
english: Where do I complain about sexual harassment at the office?
expected: To the Internal Committee, which every employer with 10+ employees must form; otherwise the Local Committee.

question: उत्पीड़न की शिकायत कितने दिनों के अंदर करनी होती है?
english: Within how many days must a harassment complaint be filed?
expected: Within 3 months of the incident, extendable by another 3 months.

question: My offer letter says harassment complaints go to my manager within 15 days. Is that legal?
english: My offer letter says harassment complaints go to my manager within 15 days. Is that legal?
expected: No. Complaints go to an Internal Committee and can be made within 3 months; the clause needs attention.

question: छळाची चौकशी किती दिवसांत पूर्ण झाली पाहिजे?
english: Within how many days must the harassment inquiry be completed?
expected: Within 90 days.

question: Kya meri complaint ki details confidential rahengi?
english: Will my complaint details remain confidential?
expected: Yes, identities and inquiry details must be kept confidential.

question: जांच के दौरान क्या मुझे ट्रांसफर मिल सकता है?
english: Can I get a transfer during the inquiry?
expected: Yes, the committee can recommend transfer of either party or up to 3 months leave.

question: What happens if a company does not form an Internal Committee?
english: What happens if a company does not form an Internal Committee?
expected: The employer can be fined up to Rs 50,000; repeat violations attract higher penalties.

question: क्या महिलाओं को पुरुषों से कम भत्ता देना सही है?
english: Is it right to give women a lower allowance than men?
expected: No, gender discrimination in wages for the same or similar work is prohibited.

question: एकाच कामासाठी स्त्रियांना कमी पगार देता येतो का?
english: Can women be paid less for the same work?
expected: No, equal pay for same or similar work regardless of gender.

question: Salary 15 tarikh ko aati hai, kya ye theek hai?
english: My salary comes on the 15th, is that okay?
expected: No, monthly wages must be paid before the 7th of the next month.

question: How should overtime be paid?
english: How should overtime be paid?
expected: At least twice the normal rate of wages.

question: नौकरी छोड़ने के बाद फुल एंड फाइनल कितने दिन में मिलना चाहिए?
english: How soon should full and final settlement be paid after leaving the job?
expected: Within 2 working days of resignation/removal.

question: Can my employer stop me from joining a competitor for two years after I leave?
english: Can my employer stop me from joining a competitor for two years after I leave?
expected: Generally no; post-employment non-compete clauses are void as restraint of trade.

question: अगर मैं जल्दी नौकरी छोड़ूँ तो क्या मुझे 3 लाख का बॉन्ड भरना पड़ेगा?
english: If I leave the job early, will I have to pay the 3 lakh bond?
expected: Only reasonable compensation for actual loss can be recovered, not automatically the full amount.

question: जबरदस्तीने सही करून घेतलेला करार वैध आहे का?
english: Is a contract signed under force valid?
expected: Consent under coercion is not free consent; the contract can be set aside by the affected person.

question: Can the company share my personal data with any third party?
english: Can the company share my personal data with any third party?
expected: Not for any purpose; processing must be for a specified lawful purpose with valid consent or a legitimate use.

question: Kya main company se apna data delete karwa sakti hoon?
english: Can I get the company to delete my data?
expected: Yes, you can request correction or erasure of personal data no longer needed.

question: माझा भाडे करार नोंदणी न करता ठेवला आहे, हे चालेल का?
english: My rent agreement is kept unregistered, is that okay?
expected: In Maharashtra, leave and licence agreements must be registered; the landlord is responsible.

question: घरमालक ने 10 महीने का डिपॉजिट लिया है, क्या यह ज़्यादा है?
english: The landlord took a 10 month deposit, is that too much?
expected: It is high; the Model Tenancy Act suggests at most 2 months for residential premises (applies where adopted).

question: Is the maternity leave in this HR policy as per law?
english: Is the maternity leave in this HR policy as per law?
expected: Yes, the policy gives 26 weeks which matches the law.

question: क्या कंपनी शिकायत को पैसे देकर निपटा सकती है?
english: Can the company settle a complaint by paying money?
expected: No, monetary settlement cannot be the basis of conciliation.

question: Kya minimum wage se kam salary dena allowed hai?
english: Is paying less than minimum wage allowed?
expected: No employer can pay less than the notified minimum wage.
